name: local-ai-coding-ide
description: Local AI Coding IDE - A professional desktop development environment

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: cd frontend && npm run build:electron && npx electron electron-dist/main.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd shared && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
